run_summary: JR Central has integrated real-time Tokaido Shinkansen operational data into the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app for international visitors. Other items include routine weather/volcanic updates and minor local tourism initiatives.

candidates.title: JR Central Integrates Real-Time Shinkansen Data into NAVITIME App
candidates.what_changed: JR Central has begun providing real-time operational information for the Tokaido Shinkansen within the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app, which is designed for international visitors.
candidates.why_it_matters: This provides international travelers with a more accessible, English-language tool to monitor potential delays or service changes on the busy Tokaido Shinkansen line in real-time.
candidates.traveler_action: Download or update the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app to access real-time Shinkansen status updates.
candidates.japanese_verification_summary: JR東海は、訪日外国人向けナビゲーションアプリ『Japan Travel by NAVITIME』において、東海道新幹線のリアルタイム運行情報の提供を2026年9月7日より開始した。
